property_summary: renounceRole must revert whenever the caller does not confirm their own account (msg.sender == callerConfirmation is required); the mutant silently succeeds for third-party callers, so for any caller X != A the call to renounceRole(role, A) reverts on the reference but succeeds on the buggy version.
change_summary: Remove the caller-identity guard, allowing any caller to renounce anyone's role.
